name: TTP-GLOBAL-LOCATIONS
ttps: Workers operate from DPRK, China, Russia, Southeast Asia and African countries while hiding location via proxies, VPNs, remote desktop software, and laptop farms.

sources.support: MSMT documents IT-worker teams based in the DPRK and dispatched abroad, including delegations in Russia, Laos, China, and African countries, and describes overseas laptop-farm support
sources.locator: report pp. 22, 52-66; PDF pp. 24, 54-68 | Original official publication page: https://msmt.info/Publications/detail/MSMT%20Report/4221

sources.support: DFAT warns that DPRK IT workers increasingly target Australian businesses while concealing their true identity and location
sources.locator: sections on threat activity and warning signs

sources.support: The joint alert says DPRK IT workers have expanded globally and use location-obfuscation techniques including VPNs, proxies, remote access, and laptop farms
